methodology: Forecast anchored on recent ACTUAL telemetry from this exact repository's own prior real, paid runs of the identical production pipeline (structural index -> discovery -> package graph -> amendment/operative-state -> semantic compilation -> verification), against comparably-shaped real credit-facility packages, per this mission's own Section 9 requirement.

thisPackageComparison.note: This package's raw text is ~2.93x Riot's own 3-document package. Discovery-stage cost is expected to scale roughly with per-document token count (one real LLM call per document processing its full text); compilation-stage cost is expected to scale much less with total document size, since it is capped at a FIXED number of compiled candidates (COMPILE_CAP=15, mirroring the Riot script's own precedent) regardless of how many candidates are discovered/eligible - each compiled call's own cost depends on that specific candidate's local context size, not the whole document.

pointForecast.reasoning: Historical anchors span a wide $0.82-$9.34 range depending on run configuration and document count/size, which does not by itself bound this package's own run below $8 with confidence. Rather than relying on the forecast's own accuracy, the actual run script (scripts/final-lightweight-unseen-run.ts) enforces a HARD, code-level budget ceiling of $7.50 (a 50-cent margin under this mission's own $8.00 ceiling), checked before every semantic-compilation and verification call, mirroring the exact enforcement pattern scripts/phase-3f2-riot-unseen-run.ts already uses in production evidence. This makes the $8 ceiling a structural guarantee, not merely a probabilistic forecast.

verdict: PROCEED - forecast is uncertain but bounded by a hard, code-enforced $7.50 ceiling (with margin under the mission's own $8.00 hard stop). The run will stop compiling/verifying further candidates the instant cumulative real cost reaches $7.50, regardless of remaining eligible candidates - never exceeding the mission's own ceiling.
